result.title: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
result.summary: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NaviGATE 多模态知识图谱补全生成框架：先对齐图结构与文本语义并注入结构 token 激活内部知识，再用检索无关/检索感知双视角指令微调，通过对比 logit 锐化强化可靠候选、蒸馏抑制误导候选，最后以结构约束解码保证实体合法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其区分可靠与误导检索证据的双视角训练及合法答案约束解码，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与受限生成的处理线索；但论文核心是多模态 KG 补全性能，未分析内部 latent 表示或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 机制，迁移需自行判断。
